issue_request: FHIR-14413 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked PA to clean up OrganizationRole text copied from PractitionerRole, rename the resource to OrganizationAffiliation, remove availability elements, add telecom guidance, and historically mentioned renaming code to relationship and making organization/participatingOrg required.
initial_application: Git commit 0b2790895e explicitly cited GF#14413, renamed OrganizationRole source to OrganizationAffiliation, activated organizationaffiliation in fhir.ini, moved organizationrole to the deleted resource list, replaced the copied PractitionerRole narrative, and removed availability elements. The current narrative and definitions no longer contain PractitionerRole semantics, but the live example and invariant-test copies still had practitionerrole.xsd schema locations and acme.org/practitioners identifier systems.
additional_context: The original application spreadsheet already retained OrganizationAffiliation.code and 0..1 organization/participatingOrganization cardinalities, and later final issue FHIR-25406 refined those definitions while continuing to use the current code element framing. Related copied-text issues FHIR-14879 and FHIR-17314 are already represented on the combined branch. Zulip and Confluence searches found no substantive community discussion contradicting the Jira/source/history conclusion.
reconciliation: Updated source/organizationaffiliation/organizationaffiliation-example.xml and invariant-tests/org-3.f1.fail.xml and org-4.f1.fail.xml so their schemaLocation uses organizationaffiliation.xsd and their sample identifier system names organization affiliations rather than practitioners.
